claims.text: Galactus offers to spare Earth for Reed and Sue’s child, whose cosmic power could take on his hunger; they refuse.
The 2025 film introduces an established Fantastic Four in a retro-futuristic world; Reed and Sue expect a baby.
The Silver Surfer warns Earth; the team follows to space, witnesses another planet’s destruction and meets Galactus.
The team flees the Surfer via a neutron-star slingshot; Sue gives birth to Franklin during their return.
The public demands Franklin; Sue maintains support for saving humanity and the baby while Reed plans to teleport Earth.
The Surfer destroys the bridges except the one Johnny protects; he identifies her as Shalla-Bal, who served Galactus to save Zenn-La, and plays victims’ recordings.
They evacuate New York underground and try baiting Galactus at the remaining bridge; he finds Franklin, and Ben helps free the stretched Reed.
Sue pushes Galactus; the Surfer stops Johnny’s sacrifice and pushes her master through. Sue dies and Franklin revives her.
The mid-credit scene four years later shows Doom beside Franklin; his purpose is not resolved in this film.
